verdict.rationale: The README shows a VLM session with `llama cli`. Independent hands-on reports confirm vision works well: llama-mtmd-cli runs quantized Gemma-3 with images loaded via '/image', handles photo description and basic OCR, and benchmarks at about 15s per image on an M1. One user notes vision support was once removed but has since been restored. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party multimodal documentation (supported VLM list, setup guide), evidence of image input through the server/web UI API.
